user.title: Bilresa Remote
user.description: Select your IKEA BILRESA scroll wheel remote (Matter).

data_description.device_id: Only devices from IKEA of Sweden with model 'BILRESA scroll wheel' are listed.

quick_setup.title: Quick setup
quick_setup.description: Optional: set up the most common use for {name} — the scroll wheel controlling lights. Leave everything empty to keep the defaults. All three channels and more options are available under 'Configure' afterwards.

data_description.scroll_wheel_mode_ch1: What the scroll wheel controls on channel 1.
data_description.scroll_wheel_target_ch1: Light, media player, or fan entities to control by scrolling on channel 1.
data_description.click_action_ch1: Action to run when the channel 1 button is clicked.

lights.title: Light settings
lights.description: Applied to all channels when controlling lights with the scroll wheel.

data_description.dim_step_pct: Change in brightness in % when scrolling.
data_description.dim_min_pct: Minimum brightness in % when dimming down.
data_description.min_color_temp: Minimum color temperature in K (color_temp mode).
data_description.max_color_temp: Maximum color temperature in K (color_temp mode).
data_description.color_temp_step: Change in color temperature in K per scroll click.
data_description.color_hue_step: Change in color hue in degrees per scroll click.
data_description.color_saturation: Color saturation in % used when setting hue.
data_description.light_transition_duration: Duration of light transitions in seconds.

media.title: Media player settings
media.description: Applied to all channels when controlling media players with the scroll wheel.

data.volume_use_up_down_for_instant: Use volume up/down actions for instant mode

data_description.volume_step_pct: Change in media player volume in % per scroll click.
data_description.volume_use_up_down_for_instant: Instant mode uses volume_up/volume_down instead of the step percentage.
data_description.volume_max_pct: Maximum volume in % for media players.

fan.title: Fan settings
fan.description: Applied to all channels when controlling fans with the scroll wheel.

data_description.fan_step_pct: Change in fan speed in % per scroll click (used when the fan does not report its own step).

data_description.on_hold_delay: Delay between repeated on-hold action calls in seconds.
data_description.max_queued_automation_calls: Maximum number of queued event handlers.

copy.title: Copy channel configuration
copy.description: Copy all settings (actions, targets, modes) from one channel to the others. The source channel is left unchanged.

data_description.copy_from: The channel whose full configuration (actions, targets, modes) will be cloned.
data_description.copy_to: One or more target channels. They are overwritten with the source channel's configuration.

remove.title: Remove channel configuration
remove.description: Reset channels back to their defaults (lights: dim, relaxed). Removing all three leaves only the global settings.

data_description.remove_channels: All button actions, scroll targets and modes of the selected channels are deleted.

button_actions.name: Button actions
button_actions.description: Actions triggered by the channel 1 button.

scroll_advanced.name: Advanced scroll options
scroll_advanced.description: Only needed for dynamic mode (input_select) or user defined actions on channel 1.

data_description.on_hold_action_ch1: Repeated while the button is held, see on hold delay.
data_description.scroll_wheel_target_ch1: Light, media player, or fan entities controlled by the scroll wheel. Empty for user defined mode.
data_description.scroll_wheel_mode_ch1: Attribute of the target entities controlled by the scroll wheel.
data_description.scroll_wheel_mode_dynamic_ch1: For dynamic mode only: an input_select whose current option selects the scroll wheel mode.
data_description.scroll_wheel_mode_ext_ch1: Relaxed: one action after scrolling. Instant: many actions while scrolling (requires the hidden sensor entities to be enabled).
data_description.scroll_wheel_user_action_ch1: For user defined mode only. Variables: scroll_clicks (1-8, always 1 in instant mode), scroll_direction (left or right).
data_description.click_action_ch1: Runs when the button is clicked once.
data_description.double_click_action_ch1: Runs when the button is clicked twice.
data_description.triple_click_action_ch1: Runs when the button is clicked three times.
data_description.long_click_action_ch1: Runs once when the button press turns into a long press.

no_entities.title: No BILRESA entities found
no_entities.description: No button or scroll wheel entities were found for {name}. Make sure the device is added to Home Assistant via Matter, then reload the integration.

instant_sensors_missing.title: Instant mode needs hidden sensor entities
instant_sensors_missing.description: Instant scroll evaluation is enabled for {channels}, but their hidden sensor entities are not enabled. Enable the hidden sensor entities of the BILRESA device (Settings > Devices > BILRESA > gear icon) or switch those channels back to relaxed mode.
